description: mod-graphql deployment configuration template. Default values are calibrated against the reference bugfest environment (3 standalone tenants, 11 consortia tenants) as recorded in 'Trillium (R1 2026) - Modules configuration details'; the CPU value comes from the most recent page that records CPU for this module ('Sunflower CSP#7 (R1 2025) - Modules configuration details'). mod-graphql is a Node.js module, so the JVM heap/metaspace values listed for it on those pages do not apply and the java section is empty. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management).

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU units for the mod-graphql container (1024 = 1 vCPU), matching the bugfest baseline

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-graphql container in MiB, matching the bugfest baseline

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-graphql container in MiB, matching the bugfest baseline

deployment.description: mod-graphql is stateless: each request is translated into WSAPI calls to other modules and nothing is stored between requests, so any number of replicas can run concurrently. Two replicas match the bugfest baseline.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts. A GraphQL query fans out to several synchronous WSAPI requests, so raise the read timeout if deeply nested queries over large result sets are expected.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: URL of the gateway used for the underlying WSAPI requests; when unset, the URL from the X-Okapi-Url header of each incoming request is used. Leave unset in production deployments.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_TENANT
EnvVars.description: Fixed tenant used for all underlying WSAPI requests; when unset, the tenant from the X-Okapi-Tenant header of each incoming request is used. Leave unset in multi-tenant deployments.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_TOKEN
EnvVars.description: Fixed token used for all underlying WSAPI requests; when unset, the token from the X-Okapi-Token header of each incoming request is used. Leave unset in production deployments.

EnvVars.name: GRAPHQL_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: Comma-separated list of schema-generation options (allowSchemaless, ignoreRamlWarnings, ignoreSchemaMapsWithInlineSchemas); the last is for the test suite only.

EnvVars.name: LOGGING_CATEGORIES
EnvVars.description: Comma-separated list of logging categories to enable (e.g. listen,url); when unset, no category logging is emitted.

EnvVars.name: LOGCAT
EnvVars.description: Abbreviated alias for LOGGING_CATEGORIES, used only when LOGGING_CATEGORIES is unset.

EnvVars.name: RAML_DIR
EnvVars.description: Directory against which RAML paths in an API file are resolved; only used when the module is started with an API file (-a).

EnvVars.name: RAML_SKIP
EnvVars.description: When set to a non-zero integer, RAML files listed in the API file but missing from the filesystem are skipped instead of causing a fatal error; only used with an API file (-a).

EnvVars.name: RAML_MATCH
EnvVars.description: Regular expression limiting which modules' RAML files from the API file are loaded; only used with an API file (-a).

EnvVars.name: RAML_EXCLUDE
EnvVars.description: Regular expression for modules whose RAML files from the API file are omitted; only used with an API file (-a).

EnvVars.name: CONSOLE_TRACE
EnvVars.description: When set to any non-empty value, every console log or warning is accompanied by a stack trace; for debugging only.

EnvVars.name: NODE_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: Options passed to the Node.js runtime, e.g. --no-deprecation to suppress deprecation warnings or --max-old-space-size to cap the heap.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of the co-located mod-graphql container, which always listens on port 3001; this replaces the sidecar's own default of port 8081, which does not reach mod-graphql. Override only if the module is not reachable via localhost from the sidecar.
